description: .NET version upgrade plan from net6.0 to net10.0 for ContosoUniversity

tasks.description: Upgrade ContosoUniversity from net6.0 to net10.0 and update 4 NuGet packages
tasks.reason: The project targets net6.0 which is out of support. Upgrading to net10.0 (LTS) ensures continued security patches, access to modern .NET APIs, and long-term support.
tasks.requirements: 1. Change TargetFramework in ContosoUniversity\ContosoUniversity.csproj from net6.0 to net10.0. 2. Update package references: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.EntityFrameworkCore to 10.0.5, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer to 10.0.5, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools to 10.0.5, Microsoft.VisualStudio.Web.CodeGeneration.Design to 10.0.2. 3. Run dotnet restore. 4. Build the solution and fix all compilation errors in a single pass. 5. Verify solution builds with 0 errors. 6. Run dotnet test to confirm no regressions.
